newsitem.title: NORWAY: SAS says 97 results seen in line with 96.
newsitem.headline: SAS says 97 results seen in line with 96.

text.p: Scandinavian Airlines System (SAS) reiterated on Friday that it expected profits for the full year 1997 to be in line with 1996.
"As previously forecast, the full-year result for SAS is expected to be on level with the result for 1996," SAS said in a statement to the Oslo bourse.

A spokesman for SAS said the company had released the statement following an article in the daily financial Dagens Naeringsliv (DN) that SAS expected to post a first-half result in line with the corresponding year-ago period.
"The article is wrong, we have never given a figure for the half year," the spokesman told Reuters.
In 1996 SAS booked pre-tax profits of 1.815 billion Swedish crowns.
